documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 269.23 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 25% year-on-year growth, while consolidated PBT and PAT grew by 35% and 38% respectively. Volume growth for the quarter stood at approximately 2%, with revenue gains driven mainly by product mix and export expansion. Management expects top-line growth between 10% and 12% over the next three years, led by market share gains in US automotive OEM supplies. The company is adding an expansion line of 5 lakh meters capacity at its existing facility by February-March 2027 with an FY27 capex plan of around INR 50 crores. Mayur Uniquoters reported robust financial performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by strong growth in export business and automotive segments alongside operational efficiency gains.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line growth of 10% to 12% over the next three years.
guidance.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects sales growth and increased momentum to continue over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: Mayur expects its US automotive business to grow by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth to be between 8% to 10% and export growth to range from 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects the increased momentum in export OEM supply to continue in the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply which are making a good contribution to our self-revenue and profitability. And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: Mayur Uniquoters maintains a potential outlook of 15% growth for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue value to increase by an average of 15%.
guidance.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

demand_outlook.claim: Standalone revenue for Q1 FY27 increased by 20% year-on-year to INR 247.03 crores, while consolidated revenue grew 25% to INR 269.23 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: In this quarter, the standalone revenue increased by 20% and PBT and PAT, both increased by 41% and 43% on Y-on-Y basis. The revenue from operations on consolidated basis is INR269.23 crores, PBT INR74.12 crores and PAT INR56.12 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth accounted for approximately 2% of the quarter's growth, with the remainder coming from pricing and mix changes.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth is driven by the volume is around 2% and remaining growth has come from price part.

demand_outlook.claim: Total export volume grew by over 9%, while domestic volume grew by 1%.
demand_outlook.quote: Export is 9% plus is the growth rate and 1% is domestic growth rate.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced a degrowth in the domestic footwear market in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: That is not necessarily true, excepting domestic footwear market where we have had a degrowth in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: The PU business remains muted at present with sales not having matured yet.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: More growth is expected to come from the automotive side in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: Export market growth for Mayur Uniquoters is expected to be higher than domestic market growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our concentration towards our export business is much more and our growth in the export market will be higher than the growth in the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic footwear sales are not growing due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: Mayur has ordered an additional production line for its current premises, expecting production to start between February and March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have already intimated in the last call also, so we have already ordered the line for our expansion in our current premises. So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The new line in the current facility will add 5 lakh meters of production capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for FY27 is planned at around INR 50 crores.
If a new international facility is finalized, capex could total INR 250 crores over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Instead of putting a new coating line in South India, space has been found in an existing facility to increase capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase. But we are not putting it in South India. We are putting it here.

capex_expansion.claim: A global location for a plant like Mexico is under analysis, with estimated capex around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, that analysis is going on. Whenever we are clear about that location, we will update you. But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has set up a new subsidiary in Europe to grow its European non-automotive export business.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have now formed a new company in Europe, and we are exporting from India to Europe, getting stock over there and tackle customers over there also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated PBT and PAT increased by 35% and 38% respectively in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: In this quarter, the consolidated revenue increased by 25% and PBT and PAT, both increased by 35% and 38%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that a sustainable EBITDA margin is 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Export shipping costs increased fourfold in Q1 FY27 due to geopolitical conflicts.
margins_costs.quote: Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for footwear soles previously increased by 2x to 3x.
margins_costs.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Paste PVC prices went up significantly and reached highs in March, but availability is no longer an issue and prices have softened slightly.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improved in the last quarter compared to the previous year, contributing to better margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to maintain current EBITDA margin levels as export business growth exceeds domestic growth.
margins_costs.quote: Our concentration towards our export business is much more and our growth in the export market will be higher than the growth in the domestic market. So, obviously, we should be able to maintain this level of margin.

margins_costs.claim: Imported raw materials account for nearly one-third of total raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of raw material inputs such as plasticizers and yarn have started moving up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Total exports reached INR 103.80 crores (including INR 73.56 crores in export OEM) and domestic sales stood at INR 143.23 crores in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Export general 30.24, export OEM 73.56, total exports is INR103.80 crores, auto OEM domestic 56.08, replacement, 36.52, footwear 41.16, furnishing 6.08 and other 3.38 and total domestic sale is 143.23.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current overall capacity utilization is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed PVC capacity ranges between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters per month.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The newly ordered coating line is expected to increase average monthly capacity by approximately 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that. So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume reached 76.3 lakh meters in Q3 FY26, including 2.56 lakh meters from the PU division.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

orders_capacity.claim: It takes approximately two years for a new plant to begin operations after a final decision is made.
orders_capacity.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not taken a final decision regarding a share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: So for buyback, we have not taken the call.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Gulf War caused pricing pressures and a fourfold increase in shipment costs during Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first one, because of the Gulf War the problem arises that impacted the price in Q1. And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices have experienced strong volatility since March.
risks_headwinds.quote: So obviously, there was an increase in the raw material prices, which started happening in the month of March. And the market has been very volatile since then.

risks_headwinds.claim: The polyurethane (PU) segment faces intense competition from China, leading to capacity underutilization.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the short term, raw material price increases impact operations because it takes time to pass price hikes on to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: External factors like war situations temporarily impacted the general export market by putting shipments on hold.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, what happened in the last quarter, because of the war situation, our general export market was temporarily impacted. Because there was some material that was supposed to go to the Middle East, but we could not dispatch that material, it was on hold.

risks_headwinds.claim: The PU division faces competitive pressure from cheap imports originating from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising local competition in the domestic market is adversely impacting footwear business growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

management_commitments.claim: Production on the new 5-lakh meter expansion line in the current facility is scheduled to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects top-line revenue growth between 10% and 12% for the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: US automotive business is projected to increase by 60% to 70% in the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: The company has set a capex plan of around INR 50 crores for FY27.
The company expects to commission the newly ordered coating line by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done. Maybe 1 month plus or minus.

management_commitments.claim: Management has set an outlook for 15% potential growth for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

management_commitments.claim: Export OEM order supply momentum from the US is expected to continue.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed new plant will take approximately two years to become operational after decision sign-off.
management_commitments.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
